title: Contact for support
body: There is nowhere to contact for support, and I’ve recently switched phones and don’t want to have to pay again for a subscription when I already purchased a lifetime subscription on my old phone.
author: Lkpg2k

title: Super helpful for staying on task
body: I have certain tasks (such as cleaning, or managing 20+ work queues) where it’s important not to either over-invest and run out of time or under-invest and let things get out of hand. I love this app, because it takes all of the guesswork out of this. I just hit start and go from one step to the next, and it has the right audio prompts to let me know when I need to wrap up a step and move onto the next thing or not. I’ve been a subscriber for several years now. In terms of improvements, the only thing on my wishlist is that I wish we could have more options for music tracks, so we could apply different music to different routines. There’s only one track right now. I think it would be nice to have 5 or more good options.
author: Horabiscus

title: Too expensive
body: Really good but only lets you have one routine for free!! I would definitely recommend if you only have one routine or willing to pay that amount of money.

title: I’m suddenly going to bed and arriving at work on time?!
body:
And I didn’t get paid to write this!! It’s crazy how much time I spent wandering around and going on my phone cos I was distracted and not clear on what my next step was in getting ready for work/bed. 
My only contrastive criticism would be a clearer way to refer friends from within the app as I couldn’t find a link to share with all the people I’ve been raving about this app to 😂 
Thank you for helping me!
author: Emulips

title: Best app ever!
body: This app is so helpful in getting me organised, especially with my adhd. It is very user friendly and absolutely what I was looking for! Before I was doing all of the timing manually and writing down every  single routine in the morning and now I can easily get ready. The timer is super helpful, it puts a bit of pressure on you but not too much. This app is so thoughtful and almost life changing. I HIGHLY recommend this app to anyone having problems with organisation or getting ready. Thankyou so much to the app developers, this is the most beneficial app ever.
author: fycyitrvviytrihgfibi

title: Doesn’t without a hefty subscription
body:
This app has a lot of promise and seems to be very user friendly, but frustratingly is not up front about the fact that you can’t use it without paying $70+ a year. I got all the way through installing it, setting it up, and creating my first routine, only to be stuck with a subscription screen. No way to exit and restarting the app does nothing.
I understand that developing an app takes effort and I’m sure that for many the subscription is worth the money but if you can’t even use a ‘free’ version with less features then the app should surely be listed as pay-to-install, not simply ‘in app purchases’?
author: sparklingturtle

title: I love this app but have some suggestions
body: This app has changed my life and I am so grateful. I just really wish that it was comparable with the Apple Watch, it would take it from a good app to a fantastic app.
author: Sashasct

title: Life changing
body: I had no idea how much time I was wasting and why I wasn’t getting the things I wanted done until I started routine flow. I was just so easily distracted, had no structure and just did whatever I thought of at the time. Since using Routine Flow In two hours in the morning I set myself up for the rest of the day. I feel less stressed and have more time. An evening routine sets me up for a better sleep and for the next day.
author: JuliaP8080

title: Many tasks take less than a minute
body: Please add seconds in so we can get genuinely faster & more accurate on tasks such as cooking, cleaning, tidying & restocking around the house! I’ve found another app that offers this & am looking to make the switch if I don’t see an update soon. I’ll share the name of the other app in another review here in 2 weeks for everyone to follow suit if there’s no change.
author: HJGriddles

title: Awesome
body:
So far the most useful app for my ADHD.
Helps me establish and stick to my schedule.
Would be keen to see an Apple Watch version of it.
author: Mingoo42

title: Amazing app
body: Love it. Amazing to help build habits and keep yourself on track.
